claim: Draw parity does not mean 'is on screen' for XOR figures: clears, scrolls and text wipe or move them without an erase, so visibility needs more than a parity count.

evidence.text: Other writers on figure bits: ROM PO-CHAR 15,777, tile writer 0xB378, CLS and clears 0xB2A6, bottom-third scroll 0xDED2/0xDEEA; XOR overlay with figures in front chosen.
